title: (No AI) Saber denies replacing Rideshare Stimulator’s writers with ChatGPT
author: Jay Peters
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/RS_storefronts_3840x2160_8.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

After a former lead writer claimed Saber "replaced me with ChatGPT," CEO Matthew Karch now claims, "Neither Saber nor Unigine have replaced any writers with AI," for the _Rideshare "Stimulator"_ game announced last month, developed by Unigine.

The writer, Stella Sacco, says differently, however, posting [on Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/antlervel.vet/post/3mssv7pyows2l) that "I was lead writer on this one! And Saber replaced me with ChatGPT midway through development. All the passenger voices were AI too. Either they changed direction at some point or they're not disclosing it on Steam."

Saber describes _Rideshare "Stimulator"_ [as an](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2366590/Rideshare_Stimulator/) "immersive driving simulation game that puts you behind the wheel …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/games/978558/rideshare-stimulator-writer-ai-saber-interactive)

title: (No AI) ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
author: David Pierce
content:
![A screenshot showing Gemini Live during Google’s Super Bowl ad](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/02/gemini-live-ai-ad.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

That’s a lot of people chatting with their AI friends all day. | Image: Google

For the 14th time, a Google product has hit 1 billion users. Google CEO Sundar Pichai [posted on X](https://x.com/sundarpichai/status/2087222656819241292) that a billion people are using Gemini every month, and that Gemini is Google's fastest-growing product ever.

A billion users is a huge milestone, but Google isn't the first AI app to hit it. OpenAI's ChatGPT hit the mark a few weeks ago, though the company buried the announcement that "more than 1 billion people are putting ChatGPT to work" in an [otherwise anodyne blog post](https://openai.com/index/how-the-world-is-putting-chatgpt-to-work/) about how people use AI. [External data suggested](https://www.reuters.com/technology/chatgpt-app-hits-1-billion-monthly-active-users-record-time-data-shows-2026-06-02/) ChatGPT crossed 1 billion users as early as this June, but OpenAI hadn't announced anything until that post on August 6th. …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/978113/chatgpt-gemini-1-billion-users)
